segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company that has not commenced operations and seeks a business combination with an established business.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated as a Cayman Islands exempted corporation on September 5, 2025, as Mercator I Acquisition Corp.

revenueModel.text: No operating revenue until a business combination; non-operating income comes from interest on trust account proceeds.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income from the proceeds derived from the Initial Public Offering and from changes in the fair value of its warrant liability.
